name: ratnesh-plugins
description: Ratnesh Jaiswal's personal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: skill-tracker
plugins.description: Records the technologies and kinds of work in your Claude Code sessions, with no project or client details, and turns them into skill summaries and resume bullets you review yourself.

plugins.name: job-hunt-kit
plugins.description: Give it a job link and get the role overview, your match score, profile gaps, suggested resume changes and a tailored resume that never invents facts, all tracked in a local dashboard.
